input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts
The issue with the password reset email linking to localhost appears to stem from the BASE_URL constant in src/notifications/templates.ts being set to `process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000"`. This means if PUBLIC_URL is not set in the environment, it defaults to localhost, causing the link in the email to be incorrect. The fix would involve ensuring the environment variable is properly set or adjusting the fallback URL behavior.

text:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts
The password reset link uses the BASE_URL which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" when the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set. This causes email links to incorrectly point to localhost. Adjusting the environment configuration or fallback logic in this file should resolve the bug.
